data.one_liner: Connect decentralized applications to mobile wallets with QR codes or deep links.
data.what_it_does: WalletConnect-Dart-SDK is an open protocol implementation that connects decentralized applications to mobile wallets. It allows users to initiate sessions, approve or reject connection requests, sign transactions, and manage sessions for networks like Algorand and Ethereum.
use_when: You are building a decentralized application (dApp) that needs to connect to mobile crypto wallets.
You need to support transaction signing and session management for Algorand or Ethereum in Dart/Flutter.
avoid_when: You are not building a Web3 or blockchain-related application.
You require official, up-to-date support for newer WalletConnect v2 protocols (this package implements the older protocol standard).
strengths: Enables cross-platform connectivity between dApps and mobile wallets via QR codes or deep linking.
Out-of-the-box support for Algorand and Ethereum networks with extensibility for other chains.
weaknesses: It is a community port and might lag behind official protocol updates.
Limited to specific built-in blockchain networks out of the box unless extended manually.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are specifically focused on Ethereum interaction and smart contract execution in Dart.

alternatives.name: coinbase_wallet_sdk
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically want to integrate Coinbase Wallet functionality into your application.
